observation: Fresh main already propagates ChangeSet file-count, write-file, total-write, browser and credential hard gates upstream into federated candidate admissibility. However ChangeSet stage also snapshots existing target preimages: each existing file must be readable within the established 2,000,000-byte file limit, and preimage bytes count together with proposed postimage bytes against the established 8,000,000-byte total. Federation received the real workspace manifest but did not use its observed file sizes for these two downstream bounds, so it could still select a candidate already guaranteed to fail staging under the observed repository snapshot.
changes: Reuse the existing workspace manifest already supplied to federated selection to account for observed existing-target preimage sizes; credential-like manifest paths remain excluded from the size map.

Mark proposals non-executable when a known existing target exceeds the established 2,000,000-byte ChangeSet read bound or when known preimage bytes plus proposed write bytes exceed the established 8,000,000-byte ChangeSet total bound.
Keep ChangesetStore.stage as the authoritative effect boundary; this is only an upstream admissibility check over the same existing limits and does not introduce a new budget or storage architecture.

truth_boundary: The manifest is the selection-time repository snapshot already used by federation. Missing or non-numeric manifest sizes contribute no preimage bytes, so this does not infer unseen file sizes. Downstream staging remains authoritative and re-observes the live workspace before any effect.
